desc: Spend more time enjoying the things you love and less time worrying, with the confidence that comes from being prepared. The SABRE 2-in-1 Fashionable Stun Gun with 120-Lumen LED Flashlight delivers powerful personal protection and everyday utility in a compact, durable design built for real life. SABRE is the #1 pepper spray brand trusted by police and consumers worldwide, including New York PD, Chicago PD, and the U.S. Marshals. The strength of SABRE stun guns is independently tested to help ensure reliable protection when you need it most. Delivering a painful 4.20 µC charge, this powerful stun gun is designed to help maximize your self-protection and provide confidence in threatening situations. The soft-touch outer shell and comfortable rubberized grip help provide a secure, confident hold during use. The built-in LED flashlight provides convenient illumination for navigating low-light environments, locating essentials, and handling unexpected situations with greater confidence. The USB-C rechargeable battery delivers long-lasting power and eliminates the ongoing expense and inconvenience of replacement batteries. Fast, convenient charging helps ensure your device is ready when you need it most. Packaging also includes access to free safety training videos to help you better understand your device and be more prepared to respond in an emergency. Backed by 50 years of SABRE innovation and trust, this stun gun delivers dependable protection, everyday convenience, and confidence built for real life.
